rule.statement: A guarantor's obligations under a lease agreement can be enforced even after the winding-up proceedings of the defendant-company have ended.
rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, the trial judge had concluded that the respondent bank had proved on a balance of probability that the monies due on the lease agreement entered into in the instant case had never been recovered by the respondent bank.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 274 of Companies Act No. 07 of 2007
